purpose: Reusable control model for GitHub Actions automation, repository scans, audits, benchmarks, migration and maintenance.

planning.crossfire_rule: Use multiple independent lanes only when the additional evidence value exceeds coordination/retrieval cost.
planning.diversity_rule: A second lane is independent only when it uses a distinct boundary, evidence class, runtime, language, provider or failure mode.

gates.capability: Identify supported capabilities/limits before selecting a tool, provider, runtime, browser, language or extraction method.
gates.policy: Apply security, privacy, access, billing, zero-cost and authority policy before capability ranking.
gates.resources: Reserve a separate bounded budget; never borrow user-serving or protected reserves for background work.
gates.provenance: Pin immutable revisions for cross-repository execution and preserve artifact/receipt lineage.
gates.failure: Classify failures explicitly; bounded retry/backoff is allowed, infinite retry is not.

execution.topology: normalize -> plan -> bounded fan-out -> barrier -> evidence normalization -> dedupe -> contradiction check
execution.work_stealing: Completed/blocked lanes may pull the next independent task only when mutation surfaces and dependencies permit it.
execution.serialization: Shared mutation surfaces and promotion/merge operations remain serialized.
execution.receipts: Every lane records status, limitation, revision, timing and bounded evidence references.
